feeds.title: Scéalta Ealaíne
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Eoin Mac Lochlainn. I'm a contemporary visual artist from Ireland. I graduated from the National College of Art and Design in the year 2000. I'm primarily a painter and I write this weekly art blog. I have made art about the Irish diaspora, art about Homelessness, and more recently, art about Climate change.

feeds.title: The Visual Artists' News Sheet Online
feeds.description: The Visual Artists' News is a Visual Artists Ireland publication printed six times a year. The Visual Artists' News Sheet Online offers our readers a platform to discuss a number of articles and topics contained in the print edition.

feeds.title: IMMA
feeds.description: The IMMA Magazine is a way to dive deeper into the IMMA Programme and hear from artists, curators, programmers, writers, speakers and cultural observers. IMMA is Ireland's leading national institution for the collection and presentation of modern and contemporary art.

feeds.title: Olivier Cornet Gallery
feeds.description: Now based at 3 Great Denmark Street, Dublin Ireland, the Olivier Cornet Art Gallery is today one of Ireland's most dynamic modern & contemporary fine art galleries. We represent accomplished and exciting contemporary Irish artists and other European and international visual art practitioners, working in a variety of media such as paintings, sculpture, ceramics, photography, fine art prints, digital art, and installations.

feeds.title: Donna McGee Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Donna McGee, a self-taught artist. My passion lies in creating original and exclusive oil paintings. Inspired by the timeless beauty of the Irish landscape. You can browse my blog to discover stories, experiences, exhibitions & the latest work by me.

feeds.title: Emily McCormack Blog
feeds.description: Emily McCormack is an Irish Contemporary Artist who has based her art studio and gallery in Co. Meath, Ireland. Emily works on all kinds of subjects from landscape to still life and is known for her vibrant color palette, thick brush strokes, and texturized paint layers. She works primarily in oil paint and pastel and her blog, Oil Painting Blog is all about oil painting and tips for the beginner artist.

feeds.title: Ennis Art School Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with all of the latest news from Ennis Art School. Check our updates on our online art classes and with our latest news posts. Ennis Art School teaches all elements of the fine arts, from painting, drawing, model making, sculpture, crafts, and computer design for all ages.

feeds.title: Felicia Thomas Blog
feeds.description: HI! I'm Felicia Thomas. I am the creator of 'Polly Dollies'. As a mixed-media artist, I love to explore the wonderful elements of acrylics, paper, and fabric to create beautiful, whimsical characters. Houses also feature a lot in my paintings. My aim is to encourage the viewer to create a story in their imagination. Many of my paintings include positive affirmations that give encouragement and support, sentiments that remain true no matter how old we are.

feeds.title: Irish Arts Review
feeds.description: Founded in 1984 and published four times a year, the Irish Arts Review is Ireland's leading art and design publication. It is committed to supporting the work of Irish artists and to celebrating Ireland's unique visual heritage.

feeds.title: Debbie Chapman Blog
feeds.description: Based in West Dublin, I, Debbie Chapman paint from my studio in Chapelizod beside Phoenix Park. On my blog, you can read regular news, updates, articles & discussions about exhibitions, my works, artistic magazine, and more and get an opportunity to engage, debate, share & converse with me.

feeds.title: The Irish Art Blog
feeds.description: The Irish Art Blog was started in August 2006. The aim was to show the social side of art in Ireland - the people behind the art. Since then we've attended numerous exhibitions. The blog features interviews with artists, gallery owners, and others involved in art in Ireland.

feeds.title: Rachael Thomas Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Rachael Thomas. I follow my own creative voice, embracing broader scale work and different paint media which can be seen in my articles. Keep up to date with the latest news about my upcoming Irish art exhibitions, initiatives, and new work.

feeds.title: Healing Creations Blog
feeds.description: Patricia Fitzgerald is a visual artist located in Dublin, Ireland. Her main focus is on the art of Mandala and the power of the mandala as a tool for the expansion of consciousness. In each blog post, she shares a mandala and the meaning behind it either in terms of process or of form.

feeds.title: Art 4 You Blog
feeds.description: Art 4 You represents artists based primarily in Ireland. From well-known professional artists to emerging artists - we are sure you will find something to suit your taste or liking. The art you see on this site is both original and direct from the artists.

feeds.title: Irish Artmart Blog
feeds.description: Irish Artmart is an Irish art marketplace of talented creatives and artisans. The blog put forwards an extensive range of articles on how to create the best work, history & evolution of art, abstract write-ups, the importance of art, how to build knowledge, and more.
